Broad locator covers two suboutcomes; retained authors printed aggregate effect from Table 1. No p printed for this aggregate; individual suboutcome p-values were not paired with the aggregate. Primary workbook rows 97,98: Coping: Active coping [ReplicationEffect=0.2822928535247974, ReplicationPValue=5.947899793645402e-29]; Coping: Avoidant coping [ReplicationEffect=-0.04683394236735301, ReplicationPValue=0.06940505820708469]. Original-source rule applied: replication project citations/quoted original statistics were not substituted for original primary evidence. DOI landing 403; Unpaywall closed with no OA location; OpenAlex no PDF; author lab publications page and title searches yielded no target full paper.
Source follow-up: Published article title and authors match the supplied reference. PDF page 7 (printed p. 995), Table 2, visually checked against the supplied scan. The table is titled "Standardized Parameter Estimates of Structural Model 1: Paths From the Personality Predispositions to the Coping Factors". Its three outcome columns are "Avoidant Coping", "Active Coping", and "Seeking Support". These are standardized structural-model path estimates, not printed Pearson r values. The supplied locator does not specify which coping factor or test to select. No coefficient was selected or converted. Contextual sample only: printed p. 992, Response Rates, states "The final sample for the analysis of coping and psychological adjustment consisted of 672 respondents who had completed both questionnaires"; student identification numbers were verified, two incomplete/improper Time 2 questionnaires were dropped, and missing scale/item values were imputed as described in Analysis. This sample cannot establish a uniquely specified target test.
